notes:
New solo rap videos keep Music Studio’s recorded voice and use its isolated vocal for lip motion. Returning performers can reuse that voice. The local director writes a music-only beat and delivery brief, and uses the larger offline lyric writer if it fits.

Rap videos now open with an audible beat before the artist starts moving their mouth. Video Studio takes the opening from the backing track, uses the isolated voice to guide the performance, and keeps the finished clip at the requested length.

Visible rap performers default to a head-to-knees shot that shows the outfit, hands and setting. Ask for a close-up or full-body shot to change it. Describe the wardrobe, jewelry, car and location in the same prompt.

The Windows export keeps a constant frame rate through the final frame, so the result passes Video Studio’s playback checks and appears in Recent clips.

Verified the native music-video tests, camera planning and exports at multiple durations and frame rates. A 15-second rap export produced audio in its first 100 milliseconds, before visible movement.
